title: Agreement Between Owner and Contractor – Native Soil Inc. – Jefferson Child Development Center Site Improvements Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Agreement Between Owner and Contractor by and between the District and Native Soil Inc., Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide construction services site improvements to include irrigation, landscaping for the Jefferson Child Development Center Site Improvement Project, in the amount of $220,000.00, with the work anticipated to commence on August 28, 2025, and scheduled to last until September 30, 2025.

headline: Pays Native Soil $220,000 for irrigation and landscaping at Jefferson Child Development Center

title: Master Service Agreement - Manhattan Telecommunications, LLC - Technology Services Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Master Service Agreement Voice, Data & IP Services and Products by and between the District and Manhattan Telecommunications, LLC, New York, NY, for the latter to provide telecommunications services to support elevator phone service, contingent upon a successful one-month trial, for the period of July 17, 2025 through July 16, 2028 at a cost not to exceed $4,792.24.

summary: The district is approving, after the fact, a three-year agreement with Manhattan Telecommunications for voice and data service that supports elevator phones. It depends on a successful one-month trial and costs no more than $4,792.24 over the term, from July 17, 2025 to July 16, 2028.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Change Order No. 1, Agreement Between Owner and Contractor - RK Roofing & Construction, Inc. - Highland Child Development Center Roof Replacement Project - Department of Buildings & Grounds
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Change Order No. 1, Agreement Between Owner and Contractor, by and between the District and RK Roofing & Construction, Inc., San Leandro, CA, for the latter to replace the dry-rotted roof deck lumber, demolish the insulation within HVAC equipment, tapered insulation in valleys and walkways; install new ISO insulation in the valleys, HVAC wells, and walk paths; hire a structural engineer, treat dry-rotted structural beams, and install six structural plates to support the beams, as outlined in PCOs No. 1 to No. 3 for the Highland Child Development Center Roof Replacement Project, in the not-to-exceed amount of $320,337.28, increasing the Agreement price from $297,000.00 to $617,337.28.  All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Adds $320,337.28 to the Highland Child Development Center roof replacement with RK Roofing
summary: This change order adds repairs found during the Highland Child Development Center roof replacement, including replacing rotted roof deck lumber, new insulation, a structural engineer and plates to support the beams. It raises the contract price from $297,000.00 to $617,337.28.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Central California Advisors - Nutrition Services Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2025-2026 by and between the District and Central California Advisors, Turlock, CA, for the latter to provide strategic consulting services to OUSD Nutrition Services Department to advance kitchen modernization, equipment acquisition, and systems, as well as student-centered dining environments; guide OUSD in creating functional, culturally relevant, and compliant spaces for fresh, scratch-cooked meals; and assist the department in designing systems that support compliance, operational excellence, and staff capacity-building, in preparation for future audits and expansions, via the Nutrition Services Department, for the period of July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026, in an amount not to exceed $132,000.00.
headline: Pays Central California Advisors up to $132,000 to advise Nutrition Services on kitchen modernization
summary: The district is hiring Central California Advisors to give strategic advice to the Nutrition Services Department on modernizing kitchens, buying equipment, and creating dining spaces that support fresh, scratch-cooked meals. It also covers preparing for future audits and expansions during the 2025-26 school year.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Change Order No. 1, CMAS Purchase and Installment Agreement - Audio Enhancement, Inc. - Lockwood Steam Academy - Public Address System Replacement & Security Enhancements Project - Department of Buildings and Grounds
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Change Order No. 1, CMAS Purchase and Installment Agreement, by and between the District and Audio Enhancement, Inc., West Jordan, UT, for the latter to provide their own network drops and upgrade to the pendant speakers, as outlined in PCO No. 1, for the Lockwood STEAM Academy Public Address System Replacement & Security Enhancements Project, in the not-to-exceed amount of $54,137.71, increasing the Agreement price from $371,459.46 to $425,597.17, and extending the term of the Agreement from June 6, 2025, through August 15, 2025, to September 16, 2025 (an additional 32 calendar days).  All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain the same and in full force and effect.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Adds $54,137.71 to the Lockwood STEAM Academy public address system project, extending it to Sept. 16
summary: This change order pays for the vendor to provide its own network drops and upgrade to pendant speakers at Lockwood STEAM Academy. It raises the price from $371,459.46 to $425,597.17 and extends the end date by 32 days, from August 15 to September 16, 2025. The original purchase was made through a state contract program (California Multiple Award Schedules, or CMAS) instead of the district running its own bid.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Trieste Huey - Nutrition Services Department

title: Construction Agreement Between Owner and Contractor – Emergency Rooter – District-wide Lead Abatement Project – Division of Facilities Planning & Management
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of the Construction Agreement Between Owner and Contractor by and between the District and Emergency Rooter, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide construction services to demolish walls, remove galvanized piping, and replace it with copper piping; install new water filters on all sinks, as further described in the Proposal, attached as Exhibit A to this Agreement, as part of the District-wide Lead Abatement Project, in the amount of $21,650.00, with the work anticipated to commence on July 21, 2025, and scheduled to last until December 31, 2025.

title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Amergis Healthcare Staffing - Chief of Systems and Services Officer
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2025-2026 by and between the District and Amergis Healthcare Staffing, Columbia, MD, for the latter to support the District’s lead mitigation efforts by providing  expert oversight and support throughout the lead testing process, guaranteeing that all procedures are performed accurately and in compliance with EPA and District standards, including important tasks such as pre-testing flushing, labeling fixtures that meet the District’s strict safety standards for continued use, and closing fixtures that test above the District’s threshold of 5 parts per billion to prevent use and assist the Plumbing Department with necessary repairs; coordinate follow-up retesting to verify that issues have been resolved; beyond lead-specific duties, … support other District departments by assisting with violence prevention plans, attendance verifications, staff coverage, family outreach, and leading community initiatives like Kaboom playground builds, via the Office of the Chief of Systems and Services, for the period of July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026, in an amount not to exceed $335,000.00.
headline: Pays Amergis Healthcare Staffing up to $335,000 for lead testing oversight and other district support
summary: The district is hiring Amergis Healthcare Staffing to oversee lead testing at school sites, including flushing and labeling fixtures, closing those that test above 5 parts per billion, and coordinating retesting. The contract also covers support for other departments, such as violence prevention plans, attendance checks, family outreach and community playground builds, during the 2025-26 school year.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Eat Better by Design LLC - Nutrition Services Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2025-2026 by and between the District and Eat Better by Design, LLC, Sacramento, CA, for the latter to evaluate existing meal accommodation protocols and identify opportunities for improvement; develop centralized and site-based strategies to support dietary needs; create staff training resources and coach the District dietitian in implementation; evaluate procurement, recipe, and labeling systems; identify strategies for ensuring accurate ingredient, nutrition, and allergen information as scratch cooking increases; develop inventory monitoring protocols and cross-contact prevention systems; develop an overarching framework for nutrition and meal accommodations; and provide program language for communications, signage, and training resources, via the Nutrition Services Department, for the period of July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026, in an amount not to exceed $55,250.00.
headline: Ratifies up to $55,250 for Eat Better by Design to improve student meal accommodations
summary: The district is approving, after the fact, a one-year agreement with Eat Better by Design to review how Nutrition Services handles special dietary needs and to build strategies, staff training and systems for ingredient, allergen and cross-contact safety as scratch cooking grows.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Solutions for You - Nutrition Services Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2025-2026 by and between the District and Solutions for You, Vista, CA, for the latter to review and redesign procurement workflows to improve efficiency and compliance with federal and state regulations; develop Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for vendor contract management, purchase orders, and commodities ordering; support bid processes and ordering revamp for school sites and the Central Kitchen; align procurement practices with Board policies and legal thresholds; provide Buyer Training to coach procurement staff in USDA Foods, vendor contracts, and OUSD financial systems; and build upon existing systems established by the previous buyer and support the onboarding of new Procurement Personnel, via the Nutrition Services Department, for the period of July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026, in an amount not to exceed $132,000.00.
headline: Pays Solutions for You up to $132,000 to redesign Nutrition Services purchasing
summary: The district is hiring Solutions for You to redesign Nutrition Services purchasing so it is more efficient and follows federal and state rules. The work includes written procedures for contracts and orders, buyer training, and onboarding new procurement staff during the 2025-26 school year.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement and Data Sharing Agreement - Newsela, Inc. - Academics and Instruction Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement (SA) and Data Sharing Agreement (DSA) by and between the District and Newsela, Inc. New York, NY, for the latter to provide, through the SA, access to the Newsela ELA content in the Order Form for OUSD middle schools and the Newsela California Ethnic Studies collection for OUSD high schools, as described in Exhibit A, Agreement: the Scope of Work, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set, forth, for the period of July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026, in an amount not to exceed $118,037.00, and under the DSA, the terms and conditions of the District's transmission of or sharing of pupil data with Newsela, Inc., and the protection by Newsela, Inc., of such data for the same term as the SA, each, via the Academics and Instruction Department.

summary: The district is approving, after the fact, an agreement with Banteay Srei Asian Health Services to run an after-school program for 40 high school girls at Oakland Technical and Skyline high schools, twice a week for 24 weeks. The program covers reproductive health, gender-based violence and building resilience and healthy relationships.
schools: Oakland Technical High School; Skyline High School
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Public Profit - Community Schools and Student Services Department

title: Services Agreement 2025-2026 - Public Profit - Community Schools and Student Services Department

outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
